finding.mechanism: preset-apply stores profile_json plus profile_sha256, while active_profile_json read only profile_id and profile_json; active profile bytes could drift from their recorded digest before status/run consumed them
finding.security_scope: integrity consistency only; the digest is unkeyed and stored beside the profile, so this mechanism is not authentication against coherent profile+digest rewriting

behavior: load profile_sha256 with active profile bytes
reject missing or malformed digest metadata
recompute SHA-256 over exact stored profile_json bytes before use
reject mismatch as PROFILE_HASH_MISMATCH before profile enters runtime configuration/cognition

regression_cases: same-length profile-byte drift rejected and generation unchanged
malformed 63-character digest metadata rejected and generation unchanged

unusual_experiment.name: COHERENT_PROFILE_AND_DIGEST_REWRITE_BOUNDARY
unusual_experiment.purpose: falsify any overclaim that the new digest fence is a trust-root/authentication mechanism
unusual_experiment.intervention: rewrite both profile_json and profile_sha256 coherently and observe whether the runtime remains internally consistent
unusual_experiment.claim_boundary: test is bound into canonical exact-repro adapter but receives zero empirical credit until an admitted job actually executes it
